chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Jameela who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Allah, Blessed and High, said: 'O My servants, the truthful ones! Enjoy with My worship in the world, for indeed you will be enjoying with it in the Hereafter.'

key_terms.الآخِرَةِ: The Hereafter, the eternal realm following death
key_terms.الصِّدِّيقِينَ: The truthful ones, referring to those who are sincere and consistent in their faith and actions
key_terms.بِعِبَادَتِي: With My worship, indicating the object of this enjoyment is the act of worshipping God
key_terms.تَنَعَّمُوا: Enjoy/delight yourselves, implying a deep, pleasurable engagement

ai.seo_question: What is the connection between enjoying worship in this world and the Hereafter according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this Qudsi hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a causal link between worldly spiritual delight and eternal reward, emphasizing that the quality of worship determines the nature of the afterlife. It reflects the Shia theological view that 'sidq' (truthfulness) in faith transforms ritual acts into a source of continuous pleasure, aligning with the concept of 'lazzah' (delight) in divine proximity.
